facts.fact: According to the page, the Millward Brown Institute's Advanced Tracking Programme started in 1976 to continuously measure how advertising affected consumer choices over time.
facts.quote: A big leap forward was the Millward Brown Institute's Advanced Tracking Programme back in **1976**, which started to continuously measure how advertising affected consumer choices over time.

facts.fact: The page says advertising effectiveness measurement evolved from simple "Do you remember this ad?" surveys that began in the 1950s.
facts.quote: The whole field has evolved from simple "Do you remember this ad?" surveys in the 1950s to much more sophisticated tracking.

facts.fact: The page defines CPM (Cost Per Mille) as the money spent to get 1,000 flyers, or impressions, into people's hands.
facts.quote: **CPM (Cost Per Mille)** is the money you spent to get **1,000** flyers into people's hands.
